sources.title: Amharic Speech Recognition — Fine-tuned Whisper Medium
sources.snippet: The VRAM cost is manageable on Colab T4 with gradient checkpointing. All 4 dialects combined: Training on multiple Amharic dialects (Gojjam, Gonder, Wello, Shewa) produces a more robust model than any single dialect alone.
